parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of brass for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to control the flow of water by rotating it to open or close the valve mechanism inside the faucet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to adjust the water flow rate.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the central body of the faucet that connects the switch and the spout, made of brass for strength and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the valve mechanism and connects the water inlet to the spout, ensuring proper sealing and flow control.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet tube of the faucet, made of brass for durability and resistance to water corrosion.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the valve to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during operation.
